title: From the Earth Greetings
question: Which life forms are most likely to develop on a distant planet?

meanings.usage: 指研究恒星、星系等天体的科学
表示通过仪器或方法发现或感知某物的存在
指由众多恒星、气体和尘埃组成的巨大天体系统
指生物或事物经过漫长时间逐渐发展变化
常与of连用，表示有能力做某事
指天体运行的路径，或绕某天体运行的动作
指包围地球的气体层，或某地的一般氛围
指产生某种物质、能量或结果
指思想、活动或知识的领域或范围
blot out表示遮住、挡住光线
正式用语，指尝试做某事或努力做的事

examples.en: In relative terms, planets are very small and do not emit light.
examples.zh: 相对而言，行星非常小且不发光。

examples.en: A planet would have to be a very long way from it to be capable of supporting life.
examples.zh: 行星必须离它很远才能维持生命。

examples.en: In the first instance, we would be looking for plant life, rather than 'little green men'.
examples.zh: 首先，我们会寻找植物生命，而不是小绿人。

examples.en: But this hope is always in the realms of science fiction.
examples.zh: 但这种希望总是在科幻小说的领域里。

examples.en: We would have to find a way of blotting out the light from its star.
examples.zh: 我们必须找到一种方法遮住它恒星的光。

examples.en: In the first instance, we would be looking for plant life.
examples.zh: 首先，我们会寻找植物生命。

examples.en: Venus is far too hot and Mars is far too cold to support life.
examples.zh: 金星太热而火星太冷，都无法维持生命。

phrases.phrase: take + 时间 + for + 事物 + to do

examples.en: It has taken more than four billion years for plant and animal life to evolve.
examples.zh: 动植物生命进化花了四十多亿年。

examples.en: It is impossible to look for life on another planet using earth-based telescopes.
examples.zh: 用地面望远镜寻找另一颗行星上的生命是不可能的。

examples.en: It is bacteria that have generated the oxygen we breathe on earth.
examples.zh: 正是细菌产生了我们呼吸的氧气。

sentences.en: Recent developments in astronomy have made it possible to detect planets in our own Milky Way and in other galaxies.
sentences.zh: 天文学的最新发展使得在我们自己的银河系和其他星系中探测行星成为可能。

sentences.en: This is a major achievement because, in relative terms, planets are very small and do not emit light.
sentences.zh: 这是一个重大成就，因为相对而言，行星非常小且不发光。

sentences.en: Finding planets is proving hard enough, but finding life on them will prove infinitely more difficult.
sentences.zh: 发现行星已经够难了，但在行星上发现生命将是无限困难的。

sentences.en: The first question to answer is whether a planet can actually support life.
sentences.zh: 首先要回答的问题是，一个行星是否真的能够支持生命。

sentences.en: In our own solar system, for example, Venus is far too hot and Mars is far too cold to support life.
sentences.zh: 例如，在我们自己的太阳系中，金星太热，火星太冷，都无法支持生命。

sentences.en: Only the Earth provides ideal conditions, and even here it has taken more than four billion years for plant and animal life to evolve.
sentences.zh: 只有地球提供了理想的条件，即使在这里，植物和动物生命也用了超过40亿年才得以进化。

sentences.en: Whether a planet can support life depends on the size and brightness of its star, that is its 'sun'.
sentences.zh: 行星是否能支持生命取决于其恒星，也就是它的“太阳”的大小和亮度。

sentences.en: Imagine a star up to twenty times larger, brighter and hotter than our own sun.
sentences.zh: 想象一颗比我们自己的太阳大20倍、亮20倍、热20倍的恒星。

sentences.en: A planet would have to be a very long way from it to be capable of supporting life.
sentences.zh: 一个行星必须离它非常遥远才能支持生命。

sentences.en: Alternatively, if the star were small,
sentences.zh: 另一方面，如果恒星很小，

sentences.en: the life-supporting planet would have to have a close orbit round it and also provide the perfect conditions for life forms to develop.
sentences.zh: 支持生命的行星就必须围绕它近距离运行，并且提供生命形式发展的完美条件。

sentences.en: But how would we find such a planet?
sentences.zh: 但是我们如何才能找到这样一个行星呢？

sentences.en: At present, there is no telescope in existence that is capable of detecting the presence of life.
sentences.zh: 目前，还没有任何望远镜能够探测到生命的存在。

sentences.en: The development of such a telescope will be one of the great astronomical projects of the 21st century.
sentences.zh: 这种望远镜的开发将是21世纪伟大的天文学项目之一。

sentences.en: It is impossible to look for life on another planet using earth-based telescopes.
sentences.zh: 使用基于地球的望远镜来寻找其他行星上的生命是不可能的。

sentences.en: Our own warm atmosphere and the heat generated by the telescope
sentences.zh: 我们温暖的大气层和望远镜产生的热量

sentences.en: would make it impossible to detect objects as small as planets.
sentences.zh: 将使我们不可能探测到像行星一样小的物体。

sentences.en: Even a telescope in orbit round the earth, like the very successful Hubble telescope,
sentences.zh: 即使是像非常成功的哈勃望远镜那样围绕地球轨道运行的望远镜，

sentences.en: would not be suitable because of the dust particles in our solar system.
sentences.zh: 也不会适用，因为我们太阳系中有尘埃颗粒。

sentences.en: A telescope would have to be as far away as the planet Jupiter to look for life in outer space,
sentences.zh: 望远镜必须远达木星才能在外太空寻找生命，

sentences.en: because the dust becomes thinner the further we travel towards the outer edges of our own solar system.
sentences.zh: 因为我们越往太阳系外围移动，尘埃就越稀薄。

sentences.en: Once we detected a planet, we would have to find a way of blotting out the light from its star,
sentences.zh: 一旦我们探测到一颗行星，我们就必须找到一种方法来遮挡其恒星的光线，

sentences.en: so that we would be able to 'see' the planet properly and analyse its atmosphere.
sentences.zh: 这样我们才能清楚地“看清”这颗行星并分析其大气层。

sentences.en: In the first instance, we would be looking for plant life, rather than 'little green men'.
sentences.zh: 首先，我们将寻找植物生命，而不是“小绿人”。

sentences.en: The life forms most likely to develop on a planet would be bacteria.
sentences.zh: 最有可能在行星上发展的生命形式将是细菌。

sentences.en: It is bacteria that have generated the oxygen we breathe on earth.
sentences.zh: 是细菌产生了我们地球上呼吸的氧气。

sentences.en: For most of the earth's history they have been the only form of life on our planet.
sentences.zh: 在地球的大部分历史中，它们一直是地球上唯一的生命形式。

sentences.en: As Earth-dwellers, we always cherish the hope that we will be visited by little green men and that we will be able to communicate with them.
sentences.zh: 作为地球居民，我们总是怀着这样的希望：我们会受到小绿人的拜访，并能与他们交流。

sentences.en: But this hope is always in the realms of science fiction.
sentences.zh: 但这种希望始终停留在科幻小说的范畴。

sentences.en: If we were able to discover lowly forms of life like bacteria on another planet, it would completely change our view of ourselves.
sentences.zh: 如果我们能在另一个行星上发现像细菌这样低级的生命形式，它将彻底改变我们对自身的看法。

sentences.en: As Daniel Goldin of NASA observed, 'Finding life elsewhere would change everything.
sentences.zh: 正如美国宇航局的丹尼尔·戈尔丁所观察到的，“在别处发现生命将改变一切。

sentences.en: No human endeavour or thought would be unchanged by it.'
sentences.zh: 任何人类的努力或思想都不会因此而保持不变。”

grammar.title: 虚拟语气 (Subjunctive Mood) - 与现在事实相反
grammar.definition: 虚拟语气用于表达与事实相反的假设情况。使用were来表示与现在事实相反的假设
grammar.structure: If + 主语 + were + 其他, 主语 + would/could/might + 动词原形
grammar.usage: 用于表达不太可能实现的假设或与事实相反的情况

examples.en: If we were able to discover lowly forms of life like bacteria on another planet, it would completely change our view of ourselves.
examples.zh: 如果我們能夠在另一颗行星上发现像细菌这样的低等生命，那将完全改变我们对自己的看法。

grammar.title: 定语从句 (Relative Clause) - 关系副词where引导
grammar.definition: 用where引导的定语从句修饰表示地点的名词，说明事件发生的场所
grammar.structure: 名词 + where + 完整句子
grammar.usage: where在从句中作地点状语，修饰其前的名词

examples.en: A telescope would have to be as far away as the planet Jupiter to look for life in outer space, where the dust becomes thinner.
examples.zh: 望远镜必须远到像木星那样的距离才能在外太空寻找生命，那里的尘埃更稀薄。

grammar.title: 强调句型 (Emphatic Structure) - It is/was + 被强调部分 + that/who + 其他
grammar.definition: 使用It is/was...that/who...结构强调句子的某个成分
grammar.structure: It is/was + 强调部分 + that/who + 句子其他部分
grammar.usage: 可用于强调主语、宾语或状语，增强表达效果

examples.en: It is bacteria that have generated the oxygen we breathe on earth.
examples.zh: 正是细菌产生了我们呼吸的氧气。

original.en: Whether a planet can support life depends on the size and brightness of its star.
original.zh: 行星是否能维持生命取决于其恒星的大小和亮度。

examples.en: Whether we can find water on Mars depends on its geological conditions.
examples.zh: 我们能否在火星上找到水取决于它的地质条件。

examples.en: Whether the plan will succeed depends on everyone's cooperation.
examples.zh: 这个计划是否成功取决于每个人的配合。

patterns.pattern: The first question to answer is whether...

original.en: The first question to answer is whether a planet can actually support life.
original.zh: 首先要回答的问题是行星是否真的能维持生命。

examples.en: The first problem to solve is whether we have enough funding.
examples.zh: 首先要解决的问题是我们是否有足够的资金。

examples.en: The first step to take is whether we should accept their offer.
examples.zh: 首先要采取的步骤是我们是否应该接受他们的提议。

patterns.pattern: It is + adj + to do something

original.en: It is impossible to look for life on another planet using earth-based telescopes.
original.zh: 用地面望远镜寻找另一颗行星上的生命是不可能的。

examples.en: It is difficult to detect planets in distant galaxies.
examples.zh: 探测遥远星系中的行星是困难的。

examples.en: It is necessary to understand the basic principles of astronomy.
examples.zh: 理解天文学的基本原理是必要的。

patterns.pattern: A planet would have to be...to be capable of...

original.en: A planet would have to be a very long way from it to be capable of supporting life.
original.zh: 行星必须离它很远才能维持生命。

examples.en: An organism would have to adapt to extreme conditions to be capable of surviving.
examples.zh: 有机体必须适应极端条件才能存活。

examples.en: A telescope would have to be placed in space to be capable of detecting small objects.
examples.zh: 望远镜必须放置在太空中才能探测到小物体。
